topic: Feature Request: AGENTS.md Support in Agent Tools

key_points: Official home of the AGENTS.md open format — simple Markdown file that guides coding agents (a 'README for agents')
Used by over 60k open-source projects on GitHub
No required fields, no frontmatter; closest AGENTS.md in directory tree wins; explicit user prompt overrides everything
Nested AGENTS.md files enable monorepo support (OpenAI main repo uses 88 files)
Emergence credited to OpenAI Codex, Amp, Jules (Google), Cursor, Factory; now stewarded by the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation
Frames AGENTS.md as 'CLAUDE.md for every coding agent except Claude Code'
Before AGENTS.md each tool wanted its own file (CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, copilot-instructions.md, GEMINI.md) → 3-5 parallel files of duplicated guidance
2026 adoption map: Codex (originator), Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Amp, Devin all read AGENTS.md natively; Claude Code (no, uses CLAUDE.md), Gemini CLI (no, uses GEMINI.md)
Symlink workflow (ln -s AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md) and git-tracked dual-file approaches
Root cause of the request: portability — one instruction file that works across every agent tool
Direct answer: 'Does Claude Code read AGENTS.md? No' — the fallback claim is wrong
Feature request #6235 'Support AGENTS.md' on anthropics/claude-code: 5,200+ reactions, 300+ comments since 2025-08-21 — largest unmet FR in the tracker by ~4x
173 distinct issues in the tracker mention AGENTS.md; related #31005 adds 220 more reactions
Operator workarounds: @AGENTS.md import (Pattern 0, now the documented default), then five copy/symlink-based patterns scaling in overhead
Key takeaway: support is a genuine gap; the demand is quantified and long-standing
2026-08-17 Anthropic closed issue #6235 as 'completed' (not 'won't fix') via Boris Cherny after 361 days open, 5,026 thumbs-up, 384 comments — but pointed only to a workaround, no native read
2026-08-25 Shopify CEO Tobias Lütke publicly threatened to ban Claude Code over the AGENTS.md refusal
Context: the issue re-opened via deliberate duplicate #78977; symlink/import bridge works but is not the structural fix
Shows the controversy: native AGENTS.md support is now a governance/business decision, not a technical one
ThoughtWorks Technology Radar rates AGENTS.md as a notable technique, not just a file convention
Describes it as 'a README for agents' — a simple convention for a starting-point file of tips, testing instructions, and commit practices
No required fields/format beyond Markdown; relies on LLM agents interpreting human-readable guidance
Positioned as foundational to 'context engineering' (Radar, April 2026)

stats.fact: Over 60,000 open-source projects on GitHub carry an AGENTS.md file (path:AGENTS.md code search, agents.md homepage)

On the 2026-07-19 GitHub snapshot: 158,592 indexed file matches for AGENTS.md vs 56,888 for .github/copilot-instructions.md, 46,772 for CLAUDE.md, and 8,392 for Cursor .mdc rules (file counts, not unique-repo adoption)
RuleStack corpus (13 Sep 2026): 617 repositories (60.4% of indexed corpus) carry AGENTS.md; median file is 857 words; 23 tools read it natively

Claude Code issue #6235 'Feature Request: Support AGENTS.md' is the largest unmet feature request in the tracker — 5,200-5,026 thumbs-up and 300+ comments since 2025-08-21, ~4x the next-biggest request; 173 tracker issues mention AGENTS.md
Anthropic closed #6235 as 'completed' on 2026-08-17 after 361 days without implementing native support, referencing a workaround; Shopify CEO criticized the move publicly on 2026-08-25
The OpenAI Codex repo on GitHub carries 88 nested AGENTS.md files for its monorepo; closest-file-wins precedence governs nested overrides

AGENTS.md originated from an industry working group (Google, OpenAI, Sourcegraph, Factory, Cursor); OpenAI and Anthropic jointly donated it to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) on 2025-12-09

Tools reading AGENTS.md natively as of 2026 include OpenAI Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Amp, Aider, Continue.dev, and Devin/Cognition; Gemini CLI uses GEMINI.md and Claude Code uses CLAUDE.md

angles: The AGENTS.md standard has won the format war — a neutral Linux Foundation governance structure (AAIF) makes cross-vendor adoption strategically safe
The gap now is adoption lag: Claude Code (CLAUDE.md) and Gemini CLI (GEMINI.md) are the holdouts, and AGENTS.md support has become a business/governance decision rather than a technical one
Quantified demand: #6235 is the single largest unmet feature request in the entire Claude Code tracker — the strongest argument that portability is what enterprises actually want
The monorepo case: nested AGENTS.md files give per-package instructions with deterministic closest-file precedence — a concrete upgrade over single CLAUDE.md
Security/governance angle: a single AGENTS.md lets teams enforce build/test/commit conventions uniformly across every AI tool, replacing 3-5 duplicated instruction files
Migration playbook: symlink (ln -s AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md) and @AGENTS.md import are today's bridges — the practical interim story until native support lands
outline: H2: What AGENTS.md Is and Why It Won — a README for agents, now the single portable instruction file across coding agents
H2: The Fragmentation It Solved — the pre-2025 mess of CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules, copilot-instructions.md requiring 3–5 parallel files
H2: How the Standard Became Neutral — industry working group → Linux Foundation Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF), 2025-12-09 donation
H2: Adoption Numbers That Matter — 60k+ GitHub projects, 158k+ indexed file matches, RuleStack 60.4% corpus share, 23 tools native
H2: Who Reads AGENTS.md Today — Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Amp, Aider, Continue.dev, Devin native; Claude Code and Gemini CLI are the holdouts
H2: The Biggest Open Gap: Claude Code — #6235, the #1 unmet feature request (5,000+ reactions), closed 'completed' without a native read, the Shopify controversy
H2: What To Put In an AGENTS.md — setup commands, code style, testing instructions, security considerations; nested files for monorepos
H2: Migration Bridges Until Native Support — @AGENTS.md import and ln -s AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md symlink patterns
H2: Checklist for Feature-Request Teams — how to spec AGENTS.md support in your tool (dual-read, precedence, .agents/skills discovery, validation template)
H2: The Bottom Line — AGENTS.md is the de-facto standard; tool support is now a governance decision and the portability payoff justifies the request
